title: InjuryType
description: Schema for a compendium InjuryType entry (Rpg/Health/Injury.cs — InjuryType class). The compendium file should be a JSON object whose keys are InjuryType IDs.

type.description: A string that points to an InjuryType in the compendium

CreationEntry.description: Every 'interval' seconds, if 'condition' is true, the specified 'injury' is created/applied.

name.description: Human-readable name of the injury type (e.g. 'Cut', 'Burn').

destruction.description: Translation key used when a body part is destroyed by this injury type.

pain.description: Pain value per point of severity.

bleed.description: Bleed rate per point of severity.

overkillMin.description: Minimum overkill percentage (0–1) needed to destroy the body part.

overkillMax.description: Overkill percentage (0–1) that guarantees body part destruction.

heal.description: Rate at which severity decreases naturally per second. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

instakill.description: If true, this injury immediately incapacitates the body part (e.g. broken, missing). Defaults to false.

creations.description: List of injuries that can be periodically spawned as a consequence of this injury.

conversions.description: List of injuries that can replace (convert) this injury over time if a condition is met.
